mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(reason_code, 3) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM base_downtime_reason WHERE reason_code REGEXP '^DR[0-9]+$'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO base_downtime_reason (reason_code, reason_name, reason_type, sort_order, remark, use_yn, reg_user_id, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{reasonCode}, #{reasonName}, #{reasonType}, #{sortOrder}, #{remark}, #{useYn}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName})
mapper.update: UPDATE base_downtime_reason SET reason_name = #{reasonName}, reason_type = #{reasonType}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, remark = #{remark}, use_yn = #{useYn}, upd_user_id = #{updUserId}, upd_user_name = #{updUserName} WHERE reason_id = #{reasonId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, e.equip_code, e.equip_name, r.reason_code, r.reason_name, r.reason_type, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, d.start_dt, IFNULL(d.end_dt, NOW())) AS duration_min FROM base_downtime d JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equip_id = d.equip_id JOIN base_downtime_reason r ON r.reason_id = d.reason_id WHERE d.downtime_id = #{downtimeId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO base_downtime (equip_id, reason_id, start_dt, end_dt, source, memo, reg_user_id, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{equipId}, #{reasonId}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{source}, #{memo}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName})
mapper.update: UPDATE base_downtime SET equip_id = #{equipId}, reason_id = #{reasonId}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, memo = #{memo}, upd_user_id = #{updUserId}, upd_user_name = #{updUserName} WHERE downtime_id = #{downtimeId}
